seriesTitle: This Monster Wants to Eat Me

episodes.title: A Girl Who Seeks Death Waits for the Sea
episodes.summary: While facing profound depression, Hinako finds herself drawn to Shiori, a girl with eyes like the sea.

episodes.title: The Sunlit Beast And The Festival Song
episodes.summary: As Shiori integrates into Hinako's class, she finds herself at odds with Hinako's best friend Miko.

episodes.title: The Sea of Hope
episodes.summary: After a disastrous festival experience, Hinako tells Shiori about the tragedy in her past.

episodes.title: An Ephemeral Tie
episodes.summary: Unexpected revelations happen when Miko stumbles upon Shiori in the middle of a kill

episodes.title: The Beast Of Affection
episodes.summary: Miko reveals the truth behind her friendship with Hinako.

episodes.title: The Shape of Affection
episodes.summary: Hinako and Shiori work through the aftermath of Miko's revelation.

episodes.title: Kind People
episodes.summary: Unsettled by Hinako and Shiori's growing bond, Miko invites Hinako on a trip to help with the basketball team.

episodes.title: The Cause Of The Cracks
episodes.summary: While accompanying the kindly older Ayame, Hinako faces an unexpected threat.

episodes.title: Said With a Prayer
episodes.summary: Shiori reveals to Miko the details of her distant and more recent past.

episodes.title: A Cold Morning
episodes.summary: As Hinako seems to hit rock bottom, Miko and Shiori struggle to pull her back from the brink.

episodes.title: Beloved Child
episodes.summary: Shiori makes a desperate attempt to get her true feelings across to Hinako.

episodes.title: Warmth on the Sea Floor
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of Hinako's crisis, the girls feel out their new normal.
